issues.finding: Primary aiResult, aiLoading and aiError lack a live region; after asynchronous keyboard submit the active element becomes the document body. Result announcement/focus must be fixed and verified.
issues.implementation: Loading uses a polite atomic status region; results are labelled focusable regions; errors are atomic alerts; success, empty and error outcomes receive programmatic focus.
issues.production_evidence: Commit c951e9f9d4df064f2a1f0c7c0098c5cd718676e3 deployed READY as dpl_CnrZN4StQodK3JR22vSL5zDUmseT on project prj_ESMpwePxMzmAPi1yu6ERTAYrU0jm. A live keyboard request for Mumbai, vegetarian, sandwich and INR200 returned Vegetable Sandwich at Thepla House Chandivali; document.activeElement was aiResult and the result region was visible.

static_observations: Responsive CSS breakpoints at 900px/600px; not a substitute for phone visual testing.
City selection has role=status and aria-live=polite.
Async recommendation states now have explicit status, alert or labelled-region semantics and focus recovery.
side_effects: No owner submission, feedback, payment, or database edits.
